description: Price-change feed: models whose price went down/up, or that were added/removed, since a date (default last 7 days), diffed between daily catalog syncs. Use type=price_down to find models that just got cheaper. No key needed.

servable.description: only models callable now via chat completions

since.description: ISO date or date-time (default: now - days)

type.description: comma-separated: price_down, price_up, price_changed, added, removed

name: list_price_changes
